page.overview:
Who is Miss Bliss?

Bliss was a fictional Moroccan jewel collector, possible bathhouse owner, and love interest of James Bond. The character appears briefly in the 1998 James Bond video-game, James Bond 007, for the Nintendo Game Boy.

A jewel collector residing in an all-female bathhouse, Bliss claims to have the "finest treasures in all Africa". Dressed in a badlah style outfit, Bliss wears her most precious diamond in her exposed navel. After breaking through an unassumingly rusty door in the catacombs under Marrakesh, James Bond accidentally emerges into the bathhouse and, it is implied, seduces her to obtain the diamond.

Caroline Bliss played Miss Moneypenny in Timothy Dalton's Bond films.
